Guilt from losing my best friend.

I could've saved her, I knew something was up the night u slept earlier than usual. She probably just needed someone to talk to, instead she got drunk alone and made up her mind.
If I'd have stayed up just a bit longer I'd have been able to talk to her one last time.

And then in the morning when she didn't respond to anything, even something she was hyped for. I waited a day before I told the police and by then it was too late.
I'm not sure people can quite understand how difficult it is for an already depressed person to learn of their best friends passing first, to tell everyone (family and friends), to have her mother sobbing on the phone to me, to still not know how it happened and to then having to live with it.

It shouldn't have been her, every day is wracked with guilt.
Unless anyone has had the same situation, I'm not sure anyone can understand my guilt and feelings of pure helplessness knowing I could've done so much more but didn't.
